title: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic
prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic smartphone selfie portrait of a beautiful young adult East Asian woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, seated inside a stylish seaside café overlooking a sparkling blue ocean. Capture the scene from a close-range, slightly elevated, front-facing camera angle, framing her vertically from the top of her head to her lower torso. Position her face slightly right of center, with her upper body filling most of the foreground and the coastal scenery visible through large floor-to-ceiling windows behind her.

She has a delicate, softly tapered oval face, a small rounded chin, fair porcelain skin with subtle peach-pink undertones, naturally rosy cheeks, a refined narrow nose, and softly defined, full pink lips forming a playful, slightly puckered expression. Her large, expressive dark brown eyes have subtle gray-brown reflections, delicate eyeliner, long curled eyelashes, softly blended pink-toned eyeshadow, and naturally shaped dark eyebrows. She looks directly into the camera with a sweet, relaxed, playful expression.

Her long, thick, dark chocolate-black hair falls naturally past her shoulders and chest, featuring wispy, straight, eyebrow-length bangs and gently tousled, softly wavy ends. Fine individual strands catch the daylight, creating realistic texture and natural volume.

She wears a fitted black sleeveless scoop-neck tank top with thin shoulder straps and a deeply curved neckline, revealing her collarbones and naturally full cleavage. Over it, she wears an oversized black-and-cream varsity-style cardigan, casually slipped off her shoulders, featuring broad cream-colored stripes around the sleeve cuffs and large cream graphic lettering across one sleeve. The cardigan hangs loosely around her arms, contrasting with the fitted top and emphasizing her naturally feminine silhouette. A delicate thin silver necklace with a tiny pendant rests against her upper chest, complemented by small silver hoop earrings.

Her left hand is raised beside her face, making a playful V-shaped peace sign, with slender fingers, decorative pastel nail art, and delicate silver rings. Her shoulders are relaxed, and she leans slightly toward the camera in a casual seated selfie pose.

Behind her, expansive glass windows reveal a sunny seaside promenade with pale stone pavement, evenly spaced concrete pillars, metal railings, shimmering turquoise-blue ocean water, and a distant coastline. A large cream-colored pendant lampshade hangs partially into the upper-left corner, while polished wooden window counters and café seating appear along the right side.

Use soft natural coastal daylight illuminating her face, gentle warm highlights, realistic skin texture, subtle shadows, and balanced exposure between the interior and bright ocean background. Simulate a premium smartphone front-facing camera with a 26mm-equivalent lens, natural perspective, crisp facial detail, moderate depth of field, realistic hair strands, refined cinematic color grading, soft pastel skin tones, luminous ocean blues, understated contrast, and authentic high-resolution lifestyle photography. No excessive beauty filters, artificial skin smoothing, anatomical distortions, or illustration effects. Aspect ratio 3:4.
